biocontainers.name: bioconductor-artms
biocontainers.summary: Analytical r tools for mass spectrometry

biotools.summary: artMS provides a set of tools for the analysis of proteomics label-free datasets. It takes as input the MaxQuant search result output (evidence.txt file) and performs quality control, relative quantification using MSstats, downstream analysis and integration. artMS also provides a set of functions to re-format and make it compatible with other analytical tools, including, SAINTq, SAINTexpress, Phosfate, and PHOTON. Check [http://artms.org](http://artms.org) for details.
